items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about the, what's this guy? Babu Augustat that played trombone that Piku talks about? [INTERVIEWEE] Augustat.

ctx.x: What about the, what's this guy? Babu Augustat that played trombone that Piku talks about?
Babu, I think he called him. He's a old town. I think he was grown when Piku was little.
